task: Lake City FL Local Keyword Research — Onyx Systems

priority_keywords.intent: Primary local service search — customers looking for general computer repair and IT help in Lake City
priority_keywords.competition: High — multiple established shops (Onyx, Baya, StarTech) plus Yelp listings; 65+ Google reviews across market

priority_keywords.keyword: laptop repair near me Lake City FL
priority_keywords.intent: Immediate local repair request — users searching for nearby laptop-specific fixers; high conversion intent
priority_keywords.competition: High — 'near me' triggers hyper-local traffic; Baya and StarTech both advertise same-day/laptop services

priority_keywords.keyword: same day repair Lake City FL
priority_keywords.intent: Urgency-driven service seeking same-day availability; differentiates from competitors who require appointments
priority_keywords.competition: Low — few shops advertise same-day without appointment; Onyx requires call-first but offers same-day most jobs

priority_keywords.intent: Growing niche demand — lost files, ransomware recovery; Baya already lists it but Onyx lacks dedicated landing page
priority_keywords.competition: Medium — Baya has data recovery section; Onyx mentions it briefly in FAQ

priority_keywords.intent: Performance optimization and Windows tuning — popular paid service mentioned by Baya; gap for Onyx which only mentions basic repairs
priority_keywords.competition: Medium-Low — Baya promotes heavily; Onyx minimal mention

priority_keywords.intent: Security-focused repair — critical post-pandemic concern; Onyx covers it but not prominently
priority_keywords.competition: Medium — HelloTech and Baya list it; StarTech less prominent

priority_keywords.intent: Trust signal — 'no guesswork', 'free diagnostics' is a key selling point used by Baya and Onyx
priority_keywords.competition: High — Baya and Onyx both promote free diagnostics; limited differentiation

priority_keywords.intent: Geographic expansion keyword — captures customers outside Lake City proper; Onyx says 'Lake City & North Florida' but doesn't rank for broader terms
priority_keywords.competition: Low-Medium — Onyx uses specific city name; opportunity for regional reach

priority_keywords.intent: Emerging demand — mobile devices getting damaged; no competitor explicitly targets mobile repair
priority_keywords.competition: Very Low — none of the three main competitors advertise mobile repair

priority_keywords.keyword: computer repair surrounding areas Lake City FL
priority_keywords.intent: Broad service area claim — Onyx uses 'Lake City, Live Oak, Branford, Jasper, Macclenny & Gainesville area'; gap for targeted neighborhood ads
priority_keywords.competition: High — Onyx claims broad coverage; competitors target specific neighborhoods

content_gaps.gap: No dedicated mobile device repair page
content_gaps.description: None of the top 3 competitors (Onyx, Baya, StarTech) advertise mobile phone/iPad repair. Mobile devices are exploding in demand.
content_gaps.opportunity: Create 'Mobile Laptop & Phone Repair' microsite section with same-day mobile service.

content_gaps.description: All competitors offer in-person visits. No online diagnostic tool or video consultation option.
content_gaps.opportunity: Add 'Virtual Diagnostics via Video Call' feature — Onyx already posts daily security tips but lacks digital access.

content_gaps.description: Onyx requires calling first before scheduling; competitors like Baya offer 'no appointment needed'. Missing 24/7 crisis response.
content_gaps.opportunity: Promote after-hours emergency line and walk-in hours.

content_gaps.gap: Localized neighborhood targeting beyond Lake City proper
content_gaps.description: Onyx mentions 'Live Oak, Branford, Jasper, Macclenny & Gainesville area' but doesn't optimize for these sub-markets individually.
content_gaps.opportunity: Create geo-targeted ads for each surrounding town/city within 30-mile radius.

content_gaps.description: Baya offers $20 off coupon; StarTech has large inventory. No transparent pricing calculator or cost breakdown.
content_gaps.opportunity: Build an interactive quote estimator showing fair prices before work begins.

weaknesses: No mention of diagnostics or security

recommendations.action: Launch 'Mobile Laptop & Phone Repair' dedicated page
recommendations.rationale: Zero competition among top 3 competitors. Mobile devices are fastest-growing repair category. Target 'mobile repair near me' and 'iPad repair' queries immediately.
Onyx posts daily security tips but lacks digital access. Competitors don't emphasize this either. Build a simple video call booking flow.
Baya offers 'no appointment needed' same-day. Onyx requires call-first. This is a clear differentiator for urgent issues at night/weekends.

recommendations.action: Expand geographic targeting to surrounding towns
recommendations.rationale: Onyx mentions 'Live Oak, Branford, Jasper, Macclenny & Gainesville area' but doesn't rank for those sub-cities. Create localized landing pages for each within 30-mile radius.
Baya offers $20 off coupon; StarTech sells new/refurbished. Customers want transparent quotes before committing to expensive repairs.

recommendations.action: Optimize for 'near me' and 'within 30 minutes' local searches
recommendations.rationale: Google prioritizes 'near me' and 'in my area' for local intent. Ensure Google Business Profile tags include '757 SW State Rd 247' and surrounding streets.
Critical gap. Most competitors require initial calls. Promote walk-in hours and emergency line.
